title: Energy and Energy Transfer
seo_title: Grade 4 Natural Sciences and Technology: Energy and Energy Transfer Worksheets (CAPS)
standard_code: Grade 4 Natural Sciences and Technology: Energy and energy transfer
standard_text: Energy comes from the Sun. Plants use the Sun's energy to grow; animals get energy from plants or other animals. Energy is transferred from one thing to another, and is needed for movement, light, heat and sound. (summary of CAPS Natural Sciences and Technology, Grade 4, Energy and Change: Energy and energy transfer)
meta_desc: Free Grade 4 Natural Sciences and Technology worksheets (CAPS): energy from the Sun, energy for living things, energy around us and energy in moving systems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: The Sun is the source of energy for life on Earth.
key_sub: Energy is passed on along a food chain.
body_html:
How to think about it

Almost all energy on Earth comes from the Sun. Green plants trap the Sun's energy to make food. Animals get energy by eating plants or other animals, so energy is transferred from the Sun to plants to animals.

We need energy to move, grow and keep warm. Machines need energy too: a wind-up toy stores energy in a spring, and a bicycle moves when we transfer energy from our muscles to the pedals.

Example

Where does a cow get its energy?

What does it eat?

Answer: from the grass it eats

Example

Where did the energy in the grass come from?

Plants make food in sunlight.

Answer: the Sun

Common mistakes

  • Thinking plants get energy from the soil.
  • Thinking energy is used up and disappears.
  • Thinking only machines need energy.

items.q: A wound-up toy car runs across the floor. Which shows the main energy conversion?
